instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a creative office studio filled with wooden shelves and potted plants. In the foreground, the woman in the beige sweater vest (R3) wears glasses and carefully sticks a yellow sticky note labeled 'GOALS' onto a transparent glass pane while looking forward. Standing slightly behind her on the right, the man in the beige polo shirt (R4) wears glasses and holds an open notebook, watching her action attentively. The scene is bathed in warm, soft indoor lighting, highlighting their collaborative planning session.
